title: ​A strong core is the foundation for everything we do #shorts
description:
​A strong core is the foundation for everything we do—from running the streets to crushing it in the studio. 🏙️⚡️
​I’m hitting D-R-E-Y today to keep the engine tight:
✅ 20 Mountain Climbers
✅ 15 Knee-to-Elbow Taps
✅ 30 Second Side Plank (Left)
✅ 15 Toe Touches
​Whether you're training for longevity or just trying to stay capable, functional core work is non-negotiable. 🧢🛡️
​Spell out your name below—who’s stuck with a 1-minute plank today? 👇
​#CoreWorkout #VintageAthlete #MinimalistWellness #AbsChallenge #ChicagoFitness #FunctionalCore
